candidate_framing: LSEG/Gemma semantic event selection with FinBERT cross-sectional ranking
purpose: Estimate an implementation-capacity bound for the already frozen N36 hybrid without changing its signal, event schedule, holdings, or execution horizon.

strategy.event_schedule: Gemma exact-extreme firm-open event counts and eligible sessions
strategy.ranking: FinBERT strongest_event cross-sectional rank with symbol-ascending stable tie-break

liquidity_estimator.adv_usd: per-symbol rolling mean of close times volume, shifted one complete session
liquidity_estimator.volatility: per-symbol rolling sample standard deviation of open-to-open returns, shifted one complete session
liquidity_estimator.missing_policy: fail closed for every non-zero order
liquidity_estimator.point_in_time_rule: neither the current session volume nor the return ending at the current open enters the estimate

impact_model.formula: additional impact rate = Y * lagged_sigma20 * sqrt(abs(trade_notional_usd) / lagged_adv20_usd)
impact_model.application: additional to the frozen 10 bps per-side fixed cost and symmetric for buys and sells
impact_model.scope_warning: Full-day ADV is optimistic for a strategy specified at the opening auction; results are an upper-bound diagnostic, not a live execution claim.

validation_gates.zero_impact_identity: With Y=0, daily gross return, fixed cost, turnover, net return, and NAV must reproduce the core ledger within 1e-12.
validation_gates.liquidity_coverage: Every non-zero rebalance and final-liquidation order must have finite positive lagged ADV and finite non-negative lagged volatility.
validation_gates.capacity_definition: Largest predeclared AUM grid point under primary Y=1.0 with positive total net return, positive net Sharpe, and every order at or below 5% of lagged full-day ADV.
validation_gates.reference_reporting: Report the complete curve plus the frozen USD 1m and USD 10m reference points even when a gate fails.

multiplicity_and_selection.interpretation: Implementation diagnostic for the existing retrospective hybrid only. It cannot rescue or promote the alpha claim and does not replace the prospective holdout gate.
